sql:
-- Final query: problem names where qualifying count > solution count
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack' AND step IN (1, 2, 3)
),
max_nonstack AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) as max_nonstack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack' AND step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT ss.name, ss.version, ss.step
    FROM stack_scores ss
    INNER JOIN max_nonstack mns ON ss.name = mns.name AND ss.version = mns.version AND ss.step = mns.step
    WHERE mns.max_nonstack_score < ss.stack_score
),
qual_counts AS (
    SELECT q.name, COUNT(*) as qualifying_count
    FROM qualifying q
    GROUP BY q.name
),
sol_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT qc.name, qc.qualifying_count, sc.solution_count
FROM qual_counts qc
INNER JOIN sol_counts sc ON qc.name = sc.name
WHERE qc.qualifying_count > sc.solution_count
ORDER BY qc.name
